hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$file" == *.py ]] && python -m ruff check --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null && python -m black --quiet "$file" 2>/dev/null || true

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$file" == */.github/workflows/* ]] && echo '{"decision":"ask","message":"About to modify a workflow file. Confirm this is intentional."}' || true
